title: Building a game for people who love franchise mode in sports games
author: blueskydreams21
selftext:
I've spent probably over 1,000 hours building "GM Dynasty" with Claude Code. Growing up, I always loved franchise/dynasty/whatever modes in NBA 2K, NBA Live, Madden, NCAA Football, MLB Baseball, and FIFA. 

I'm 31 years old. In March, my original Xbox One broke, and instead of buying a new one, I decided to build the type of franchise mode I always wanted. Back in 2023, I remember talking to my little brother about how I thought LLMs would change video games because you would be able to have real dialogue with NPCs. I've worked hard to make the NPCs have persistent memories in my game. If you back out on a promise to an agent, he'll remember. The art for the game is inspired by the Community episode "Digital Estate Planning." The game is half NBA satire and half really serious sports sim.

I am dying for feedback on the landing page and the game: gmydynastygame.com. The game is set up as a subscription model because of the ongoing need for tokens that power the most fun part of the game--messing with the NPCs. You can play the first season for free. I am trying to find ways to reduce LLM costs, including caching and using lower-cost models where it won't impact the quality of the game. I have a Kanban board with dozens of improvements and features planned. Thanks for your help!

[gmdynastygame.com](http://gmdynastygame.com)
